A close through it, not a wick, is the confirmation - price already wicked to 64,588.8 this morning and could not hold it. decisionBox.changed: The overnight gap resolved in favour of the bulls on all three counts the endday report was watching, and the wallet acts on it with a small spot add rather than sitting on the trim. FIRST, the ETF print landed: Farside's 04 Aug row filled in at +$211.5M, following +$170.1M on 03 Aug - two consecutive positive days worth $381.6M, and the biggest single day since 30 Jul. That was the specific catalyst the endday report said could hit a market that had just spent its short-side fuel, and it went the other way. SECOND, the 63,760 stop was never tested; the session low of 63,880.7 held 120.7 points clear of it, and the 830.75K pool the endday surface put at 63,338 was never approached. THIRD, the structure has deepened rather than faded: the UTC daily candle closed at 64,090.6 above the daily EMA20 at 63,985.51 for the SECOND day running, price is above all four 1h EMAs (64,193 / 63,956 / 63,781 / 63,847), all four 4H EMAs (63,769 / 63,804 / 63,948 / 63,911) and all four 15m EMAs, and the 4H MACD histogram is +97.81 with the line at +172.90. Positioning is the cleanest it has been: funding has collapsed to 0.00074% per eight hours from 0.0029% last night - effectively zero, so nobody is paying to be long - while open interest has climbed 2.3% to $2.025B since 23:04 COT. Rising OI with flat funding is spot-led buying, not leverage chasing. The long/short account ratio is 1.35 against a 2.17 peak thirty hours ago. AND THE OFFSET, which is why confidence only edges from 6.0 to 6.25 rather than jumping: the UTC daily EMA50 at 64,665.88 is 139.5 points overhead and has rejected every bounce of this leg, the daily MACD line is still below its signal at -90.11 versus +44.60, the 64,300-64,500 short-liquidation fuel has now been burned TWICE inside eighteen hours ($3.88M of shorts against $991.6K of longs, with $1.93M of it concentrated in the 64,500 bucket alone), and Fear & Greed reads 27 - outright Fear - while QQQ, VOO and JPXN all sit in the RICH zone with VOO and JPXN literally at the top of their trailing-21 windows. The equity tailwind is fully priced; the marginal buyer it was going to deliver has arrived.

calibration.rollingRecord: The endday call was structurally right and tactically slightly expensive. Its bullish read was correct: it identified the daily EMA20 reclaim as the key event and price has since extended to 64,588.8, 519.3 points above the 64,069.5 snapshot. Its 63,760 reduce level was never approached - the session low of 63,880.7 held 120.7 points clear - so the recommended resting stop did its job by not firing. But the 10% spot trim it booked as overnight insurance sold roughly 19 USDT of BTC at 64,069.5 into a market that is now 64,526.4, a drag of about 0.13 USDT. It also called the magnet map 'roughly balanced' with the nearest pool above at 64,835 and, on this morning's realized data, price stopped 246 points short of that. Net: right on direction, marginally over-cautious on sizing.
calibration.note: One honest mark. The endday report put heavy weight on the missing Farside print as a live negative-surprise risk into the gap, and it landed at +$211.5M - the second-best day in a fortnight. That is not a scoring error, since flagging a genuinely unknown binary is exactly right, but it is a reminder that an unresolved catalyst is not a bearish catalyst. The lesson carried forward is to state unresolved prints as two-sided, which is what this morning's report does with the 05 Aug row that is still blank.
